label: VERIFIED
extraction: Blueprint plan mutation protocol and anti-pattern catalog. Plan mutation protocol: steps can be split, inserted, skipped, reordered, or abandoned with formal protocols and audit trail. Zero runtime risk: pure Markdown skill, no hooks/shell scripts/executable code/package.json/build step - nothing runs on install or invocation beyond native Markdown skill loader. Anti-pattern catalog used in adversarial review gate (Phase 4): reviewers check for completeness, dependency correctness, and anti-pattern detection. Branch/PR/CI workflow built into every step, degrades gracefully to direct mode when git/gh absent. Parallel step detection via dependency graph identifies steps with no shared files or output dependencies. Cold-start execution: every step includes self-contained context brief so fresh agent executes without prior context. Example: /blueprint myapp "migrate database to PostgreSQL" produces 5 steps with dependencies; /blueprint chatbot "extract LLM providers into plugin system" produces parallel steps (implement Anthropic plugin + implement OpenAI plugin run in parallel after plugin interface step).
